title: core.value — a dumped value
description: The structured form of dump()/console.log(x). Renderers show `value` as a JSON tree. SDKs encode values JSON cannot hold with the markers below.

value.description: Any JSON. Markers: {"$ref": path} for cycles, {"$bin": base64} for bytes, {"$truncated": true} where depth/size limits cut.

type.description: Source-language type name, e.g. App\Models\Order, dict, Map<String, int>.
